conventions: Every step under a call comes from the sealed ledger — nothing here is reconstructed from memory.
EARLY and RIPTIDE WHY / EXIT lines are the engines' own sealed words, quoted.
PLAIN seals its call fields, not a sentence; its WHY is read off those sealed fields and marked as such.
Play-along: $5.00 start per run, $5-run sizing law in continuous form, taker fee 0.0695 on entries (and on value exits).
PLAIN / EARLY money replays enter only where the REAL watch sealed a market ask for that window; other calls count in streaks and are marked UNPRICED.
BANKING RULE 1 — FAIL → START OVER: an engine that needs funds and cannot borrow fails its run and restarts at $5.00. Failed runs stay on the record; savings never resets.

BANKING RULE 2 — CASH-IN → SAVINGS: an early exit that locks profit (EARLY's 88¢ value line, RIPTIDE's early take-profits) sends the profit to a savings pile the engine can never spend; principal returns to the play bank. Settled wins are not cash-ins — their profit stays in the bank.

BANKING RULE 3 — BORROWING, STAGE 1 ONLY: an engine that needs funds borrows $0.50 from the richest peer that stays at/above its own $1.00 lock. Proceeds repay debt before profit counts (this play's borrowed principal, then older debt, then the savings skim). A failed run's debts are written off on BOTH engines' records.

BANKING RULE 3, STAGE 2 — BUILT, PROVISIONAL DEFINITION: an engine that "makes 5" unlocks borrowing from ITS OWN BANK — at need it stakes out of its own reserve, below the $1.00 lock, until truly broke, and only then fails. "Makes 5" = 5 straight wins (main's reading, PROVISIONAL in the record until David says otherwise; it is one named constant — MAKES_5 — and changes on his word alone). A proven engine goes to its own bank instead of the other engines. Savings stays untouchable even then.

THE BORROWS ARE COUNTED: every borrow is a STATE step in the sub-record of the play that caused it, tagged by source — PEER (the other engines), SELF (its own bank), MAN (the house treasury, David). A run's restart is staked by The Man and counts as a MAN borrow. Each board shows the running counts per source. No borrow happens silently.

RISE-THEN-BUST: each board also counts closed runs that climbed above their $5.00 start (in profit at some point) and still ended broke. A run that never got above water does not count; a live run does not count until it ends.

THE WINNER'S PROOF (the grading lens for this whole record, David 2026-11-14): a true winner keeps winning and never has to borrow from itself in hope. The borrow-from-self count is the tell — for a true winner it stays at zero as it learns; in the learner a self-borrow is a negative signal (hope, not a play), weighed accordingly. The savings pile growing with a zero self-borrow count beside it is what "proven winner" means here. For PLAIN, which never takes value early by rule, the pile to watch is the play bank itself; the tell is the same.
The COUNTERFACTUAL line is what the bank would have been with no banking rules at all — no skim, no restarts. For RIPTIDE it is the engine's actual sealed book.
Settlement is the stand-in index (median Coinbase + Kraken) unless a record says Gamma — labeled in every settle step.
